description: Election Commission - Declare that a member of the Nawagaththegama Pradeshiya Sabha has Vacated his Office of member
reasoning: This gazette contains multiple notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their offices as members of the Nawagaththegama Pradeshiya Sabha due to ceasing to be members of a political party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials in local government, falling clearly under the Elections category (Type 7) which covers electoral matters including declarations about elected officials.
